       SUM(CASE WHEN T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_charter,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_flag
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499;
